environment_understanding_summary.primary_objective: Land at the pad (0,0) as fast as possible with least fuel spent

target_alignment_summary.description: Land the rocket at coordinates (0,0) as fast as possible with minimal fuel consumption.
constraints: Ensure stable landing (low velocity/angle at contact)

reward_schema_summary.reward_function_signature: def compute_reward(self, state, m_power, s_power, terminated):
reward_schema_summary.design_principle: Controlled descent reward with distance shaping, continuous velocity penalty, and activated terminal success signal. Avoids free-fall exploitation by removing Y-descent incentive.

behavior_trajectory_prior_used.phase_1_descent_alignment: Penalize distance to target (0,0) without rewarding gravity-assisted fall; penalize high velocity continuously
behavior_trajectory_prior_used.phase_2_soft_landing: Terminal success bonus (+100) gated by low velocity and contact at termination
behavior_trajectory_prior_used.avoid_overpenalizing_fuel: Light fuel cost (-0.5) to allow necessary braking thrusts

component_catalog.purpose: Encourage episode completion speed, prevent infinite hovering
component_catalog.expected_effect: Small negative reward per step (-0.1) to discourage stalling without overwhelming other signals
component_catalog.activation_reason: Essential for preventing passive policy local optima where agent does nothing until crash

component_catalog.purpose: Encourage fuel efficiency without over-constraining early exploration
component_catalog.expected_effect: Light penalty (-0.5 * (m_power + s_power)) to encourage efficient thrusting while allowing correction maneuvers
component_catalog.activation_reason: Task goal includes minimizing fuel; light weight allows learning basic control first
component_catalog.anti_hacking_role: Prevents wasteful continuous thrusting without progress

component_catalog.purpose: Encourage descent toward pad center (0,0) via distance penalty
component_catalog.expected_effect: Negative reward proportional to Euclidean distance from target; guides agent toward landing zone without rewarding free-fall
component_catalog.activation_reason: Core task objective is landing at pad; provides dense progress signal during descent phase while preventing Y-exploitation
component_catalog.anti_hacking_role: Prevents agent from drifting away or falling uncontrollably to reduce Y error

component_catalog.purpose: Encourage upright orientation for stable landing
component_catalog.expected_effect: Positive reward when angle approaches 0 (upright); critical for successful touchdown
component_catalog.activation_reason: Upright orientation is prerequisite for soft landing; provides shaping during alignment phase
component_catalog.anti_hacking_role: Prevents agent from learning to land sideways or upside down

component_catalog.purpose: Penalize high velocity magnitude continuously during flight
component_catalog.expected_effect: Negative reward proportional to squared velocity; discourages uncontrolled acceleration from gravity
component_catalog.activation_reason: Prevents free-fall exploitation by making high speed costly regardless of position progress
component_catalog.anti_hacking_role: Discourages crashing hard to end episode quickly

component_catalog.purpose: Detect successful landing via state inspection at termination
component_catalog.expected_effect: Large positive reward (+100) only if terminated AND leg contact AND near center AND low velocity AND upright
component_catalog.activation_reason: Activated to provide clear goal signal for successful landing behavior
component_catalog.anti_hacking_role: Distinguishes soft landing from crash termination

component_catalog.purpose: Track total fuel consumption for diagnostics and future reward shaping
component_catalog.expected_effect: Maintains running sum of fuel used; enables fuel efficiency metrics in individual_reward
component_catalog.activation_reason: Required for diagnostic tracking even if not directly rewarded yet

component_catalog.purpose: Track episode duration for diagnostics and time efficiency metrics
component_catalog.expected_effect: Maintains step count; enables time-based termination detection
component_catalog.activation_reason: Required for diagnostic tracking of episode length

component_catalog.purpose: Heavy penalty for crash termination (game_over or out of bounds)
component_catalog.expected_effect: Large negative reward (-100) on crash; will activate when agent needs explicit failure signal
component_catalog.activation_reason: Dormant to avoid over-penalizing early exploration failures per memory evidence
component_catalog.anti_hacking_role: Prevents immediate crash exploitation if step cost is too high

component_catalog.purpose: Penalize high angular velocity during flight (instability)
component_catalog.expected_effect: Negative reward for rapid rotation; encourages stable trajectory
component_catalog.activation_reason: Dormant to allow exploratory orientation corrections
component_catalog.anti_hacking_role: Prevents oscillating behavior that wastes fuel

component_catalog.purpose: Penalize high velocity when legs touch ground (hard landing)
component_catalog.expected_effect: Negative reward proportional to velocity magnitude at contact; discourages hard crashes
component_catalog.activation_reason: Replaced by continuous velocity_penalty_flight for broader control signal
component_catalog.anti_hacking_role: Prevents agent from exploiting 'not awake' by crashing hard enough to stop physics

iteration_policy.iter1_principle: Controlled descent with distance shaping and velocity penalty; terminal success signal active to guide goal-directed behavior.
iteration_policy.future_search_principle: Future iterations may activate crash_penalty or angular_velocity_penalty if agent learns basic control but exhibits instability or risky termination behaviors.
